g_ee748f7b362b.title: Add parseBytes to pretty-bytes for the storage web app

links.evidence: Nov 3 ask: "This branch is what the billing service pins. They want the same thing: a named export `parseBytes(string)` returning bytes" repeats the open request's named export `parseBytes(string)` on the same branch, the same day.
Nov 3 ask: "Let's finish parseBytes: add kB/KB, MB, GB, TB and the rest of the units without the `i`" finishes the open request's parseBytes work, which deferred the kB/MB units to later.

anchorAsk.text: This branch is what our storage web app pins. They need the reverse of prettyBytes: a named export `parseBytes(string)` that returns a number of bytes. Start with plain numbers (`'512'`, `'512 B'`) and the binary units (`KiB` … `YiB`), fractional values allowed (`'1.5 KiB'` → 1536), units case-sensitive like our output. Leave out kB/MB/GB and friends for now; I still have to check with the storage team how they want those read. Tests and types please.
